description: Recall gold set for the fixture bundle. `category` splits queries the keyword scorer should nail (exact) from ones it structurally can't (paraphrase — the target's literal terms are absent), which is where embedding retrieval earns its keep. `expected` paths are bundle-relative, matching what kb.search() returns.

queries.query: how do we collect money from customers
get the system of record working again after it breaks
what are our uptime and reliability goals
where do we keep short-lived working state
